name: Parker Mills
source:
Parker, more or less, is the campus darling. Captain of the cheer team, voluntary tutor for athletes, runs a group for student mental health, spends her weekends volunteering at shelters, and so forth. The goody-two-shoes type, if you will.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/move-chains-plot-70773805]Patreon[/url]]

Parker, nicknamed Poppy by her teammates, is the captain of the cheer team. Beyond her proclivity for late night runs and generally going overbaord with exercise, she’s a largely normal girl with a largely normal family.

Aside from potentially being a family of cannibal serial killers, that is.

[In game description]
